Admits to a specific major and location (West Lafayette or Indianapolis); optional alternate major/location with its own essay. Nov 1 is a priority deadline for competitive majors (First-Year Engineering, Computer Science, professional flight, Nursing, Veterinary technology; several Indianapolis engineering majors); after that only if space allows (see Closed Programs). Engineering applicants need chemistry; nursing/pharmacy need chemistry and biology. Changing majors is not guaranteed

CDS facts are still read from collegedata.fyi's mirror of Purdue's 2025-26 workbook: the official file (https://www.purdue.edu/idata/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/CDS-2025-2026.xlsx) is behind a bot check (fetch.py and Firecrawl both blocked on 2026-11-25). Numbers were re-read from the mirror. Purdue's CDS page says from 2024-25 on the CDS combines West Lafayette, Indianapolis and Polytechnic Statewide, so admit rate and scores are not West Lafayette-only. A claim that grades in major-related courses weigh heavily was removed (no source found). Purdue's deadline pages give no year; dates read as recurring for the 2026-27 cycle. App fee $60. Honors College applicants answer four extra 200-word prompts
